items.title: Consume an Alcoholic Beverage
items.detail: Get from a C.A.M.P. Brewing Vat or another player's C.A.M.P.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted weapons, junk, chems, or food to a vendor for fastest completion.

items.title: Collect Energy Ammo
items.detail: Take from stash or craft at a Tinker's Workbench under Ammo - Energy.

items.title: Collect a Blood pack
items.detail: Fast travel to Summersville and loot Blood Eagles or check first aid boxes.

items.title: Kill an Enemy in the Cranberry Bog Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Crimson Prospect and kill Blood Eagles.

items.title: Kill an Enemy in the Toxic Valley Region
items.detail: Fast travel to Grafton Steel for Super Mutants.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Concrete
items.detail: Craft Bulk Concrete at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it.

items.title: Build a Turret or Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any turret or trap under Defense in build menu; Punji Board requires 4 steel and 8 wood.

items.title: Harvest a Prickeye
items.detail: Fast travel to Tycoon Lake in Burning Springs and harvest orange bulbs, or plant in C.A.M.P. as Slipper Cactus.

items.title: Kill Insects
items.detail: Visit Giant Teapot for bees or Tanagra Town for Cave Crickets in the giant tree cave.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Only appears at Head Hunt during Slasher event's last stage; check Highway Town Bounty Board.

items.title: Kill a Cultist
items.detail: Fast travel to Point Pleasant for up to 34 Cultists; target heads with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Repair Armor, Weapons, or Power Armor
items.detail: Get a Protest Sign from Grafton, degrade it on an enemy, then repair with wood at a workbench.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Acid
items.detail: Craft Bulk Acid at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Crystal
items.detail: Scrap crystal liquor decanters or floater freezer pus sacs; find decanters at Clancy Manor.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Fast travel does not count; sprint over flat terrain like the route north from Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Weekend event featuring increased caps rewards and double mutations in public events.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events spawn with mutated modifiers offering bonus rewards in Mutated Party Packages.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Weekend event providing double experience points for all activities.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Weekend event featuring the Treasure Hunter event with double mutations.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Festive event with holiday-themed Scorched enemies dropping unique seasonal rewards.
